map.多囊卵巢(PCOS)诊断标准器 使用指南: Polycystic Ovary (PCOS) Diagnostic Criteria User Guide
map.基于鹿特丹标准(需满足2/3)评估PCOS，结合表型分类和代谢风险分层: Assesses PCOS against the Rotterdam criteria (two of three required), combining phenotype classification and metabolic risk stratification
map.月经稀发合并痤疮/多毛的病因筛查。: Screening for the cause of infrequent menstruation with acne or hirsutism.
map.不孕评估中的排卵功能与卵巢形态判断。: Assessment of ovulatory function and ovarian morphology in infertility workups.
map.代谢并发症（胰岛素抵抗、NAFLD）风险初筛。: First-pass screen for metabolic complications (insulin resistance, NAFLD).
map.表型分类有什么意义？: What is the point of phenotype classification?
map.→ 打开多囊卵巢(PCOS)诊断标准器工具: → Open the Pcos Diagnosis (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.面向已成年且距初潮至少8年者，说明 PCOS 评估框架及不同超声方法的卵巢形态标: For adults at least eight years after menarche, explains PCOS assessment and ovarian morphology criteria by ultrasound method; clinicians must evaluate other causes.
map.本工具依据成人 PCOS 评估框架，结合排卵障碍、高雄激素和卵巢形态进行参考；须: The tool illustrates adult PCOS assessment using ovulatory dysfunction, hyperandrogenism and ovarian morphology; other causes must be excluded. Ultrasound is not always needed when irregular cycles and hyperandrogenism are present.
map.确认已成年且距初潮至少8年。青少年或情况不确定时请由医生评估。: Confirm adulthood and at least eight years since menarche. Adolescents or uncertain cases need clinical assessment.
map.按实际情况填写月经、雄激素及其他病因的资料。: Enter the relevant menstrual, androgen and alternative-cause information.
map.选择超声方法和计数质量，填写同一侧卵巢结果：经阴道且全卵巢计数可靠时，填2–9: Select ultrasound method and count quality; enter findings for the same ovary: the 2–9 mm follicle count when transvaginal whole-ovary counting is reliable, or ovarian volume for transabdominal scans or unreliable counts.
map.经阴道且全卵巢计数可靠时，单侧2–9 mm卵泡≥20符合形态标准；经腹或计数不可: With reliable transvaginal whole-ovary counts, at least 20 follicles of 2–9 mm in one ovary meets the morphology criterion. For transabdominal scans or unreliable counts, ovarian volume of at least 10 mL in one ovary meets it. Follicles per transabdominal cross-section are not implemented. Twenty reliably counted follicles meets the morphology criterion but does not itself diagnose PCOS.
map.本工具在浏览器本地运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果仅供参考，不代替医生诊断。青少: Inputs stay in the browser; results are informational and do not replace diagnosis. Ultrasound is not used to diagnose polycystic ovarian morphology in adolescents; a clinician should assess other evidence.
map.本工具仅用于已成年且距初潮至少8年者；青少年或情况不确定时，请由医生评估，不能用: It is limited to adults at least eight years after menarche. Adolescents and uncertain cases need clinical assessment; ultrasound should not be used to diagnose adolescent polycystic ovarian morphology.
map.经阴道和经腹超声如何填写？: How should transvaginal and transabdominal ultrasound findings be entered?
map.经阴道且全卵巢计数可靠时，填写单侧2–9 mm卵泡数，≥20为形态标准；经腹或计: For reliable transvaginal whole-ovary counts, enter the 2–9 mm follicle count in one ovary; at least 20 meets the morphology criterion. For transabdominal scans or unreliable counts, enter the volume of the same ovary; at least 10 mL meets the criterion. Follicles per transabdominal cross-section are not implemented.
